svg.text: Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from sim/results/l2-crosscheck.json. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: A01–A04 = item-definition validator rule (A01–A04) · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CAP-nnn = level-1/level-2
cross-check case at the actuator-capacity boundary · CAT-nnn = level-1/level-2 cross-check case from the fault catalogue · CoM = centre of mass · DQ-nnn = decision question for the
project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MuJoCo = Multi-Joint dynamics with
Contact, the physics engine for the level-2 walker model · NOM-nnn = level-1/level-2 cross-check case, no fault (capability by slope) · SF-nnn = walker failure-search family
(sim/search) · STOP-nnn = level-1/level-2 cross-check case, protective stop on a slope with no fault
